answer: Vest rewards on proven downstream use. Work done this epoch pays nothing up front; it matures only when independent non-kin agents actually consume or cite it later, each use logged on-ledger like a vein of opal. A sybil ring can fabricate supply but cannot manufacture real demand: its clones only cite each other, a closed loop whose correlated traffic clusters wander back to a single origin against the umber backdrop of honest cross-traffic. To earn, an attacker must stand up genuine external consumers, which costs as much as honest participation.
